title: enneapogon polyphyllus
intro: Enneapogon polyphyllus, commonly known as Kangaroo Grass, is a native Australian plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in Australian Aboriginal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Enneapogon polyphyllus are attributed to its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
